scope: Obstfeld and Rogoff (1996), Chapter 2 and Supplements A-C: dynamics of small open economies. Phase 2a (deterministic core): present values and discounted telescoping; the period budget constraints plus transversality are equivalent to the intertemporal budget constraint, no-Ponzi, solvency and debt limits; sufficiency and necessity of the Euler equation, binding budget, tilt, dynamic consistency, Strotz; finite and infinite-horizon consumption functions, CRRA optimality and non-existence, the CRRA Bellman fixed point, endogenous labour; the fundamental current-account equation in flat, tilted and variable-rate forms; Tobin's q with the corrected forward solution, saddle-path theorem and marginal = average q; linear difference equations (Supplement C); Exercises 1, 2 and 9.
source: Maurice Obstfeld and Kenneth Rogoff (1996), Foundations of International Macroeconomics, MIT Press, Chapter 2, pp. 59-128, and Supplements to Chapter 2, pp. 715-741.
